character: A state-owned ski mountain in the southern Adirondacks near North Creek, run by ORDA, spread across several connected peaks with a mix of groomed trails and glades. The North Creek Ski Bowl area is linked to the main mountain.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the main base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No 2026-27 opening or closing date found in research as of 2026-09-28. ORDA announced its 2025-26 opening dates for Belleayre, Gore and Whiteface only on 2025-11-21 (see the ORDA release in More links), so 2026-27 dates may not appear until around November 2026. The 2025-26 Gore date itself and past actual opening dates were not captured.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79 to Binghamton, I-88 E to Schenectady, I-87 N to Exit 23 (Warrensburg), then NY-28 N to North Creek); not a routing-service result. Alternative via I-81 N and the NY Thruway (I-90) to Albany is similar. Winter conditions add time.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-87 N to Exit 23, then US-9/NY-28 N to North Creek); not a routing-service result.
